title: 2002 SEMCOG annual precipitation
html:
2002 Annual precipitation

Station totals range from 18.80 inches at O-07 in central Oakland County to 35.31 inches at M-03 in southeastern Macomb County. Areas below 24 inches include east-central Macomb County, a southwest-to-northeast band across central Oakland County, and southern Livingston County with adjacent Washtenaw County. Contours are labeled at 2-inch intervals.

The map covers Livingston, Oakland, Macomb, Washtenaw and Wayne Counties. Crosses locate rain gauges; asterisks mark roof-exposure gauges. Black contour lines connect equal values.

Annual precipitation totals from Table 1; amounts are inches. Monthly values and the four station-reliability columns remain in the source PDF.

O-20 is printed as 6.17T. Its January–March amounts are 2.15, 2.10 and 1.92 inches; April–December are marked M, and the source reports nine missing months. This partial total is not comparable with a complete annual total. Table 2 prints M-06 as 25.27 inches, while Table 1 prints 23.62 inches; the Table 1 value is retained here.
